Sports Stars Sidelined by Injuries Requiring Surgery

Boston Red Sox third baseman Rafael Devers' season has concluded due to a core muscle injury, with potential surgery being considered. Separately, Los Angeles Rams defensive end Myles Garrett is set to undergo knee surgery and will be placed on injured reserve. This injury is viewed as a warning sign for the Rams' defense, which is described as suddenly fragile.
